sql.query: SELECT t.id tenantId,t.tenantName,m.id moduleId,m.moduleCode,m.moduleName,m.moduleDescription,m.isCore,m.isBillable,m.defaultMonthlyPrice,m.defaultAnnualPrice,m.currencyCode catalogueCurrency,tm.id tenantModuleId,COALESCE(tm.status,'DISABLED') status,COALESCE(tm.billingInterval,CASE WHEN m.isCore=1 THEN 'INCLUDED' ELSE 'MONTHLY' END) billingInterval,tm.monthlyPrice,tm.annualPrice,COALESCE(tm.currencyCode,m.currencyCode) currencyCode,tm.accessStartDate,tm.accessEndDate,tm.trialEndsDate,tm.enabledDate,tm.disabledDate,COALESCE(tm.autoRenew,0) autoRenew,tm.billingReference,tm.notes FROM tbl_tenants t INNER JOIN tbl_modules m ON m.id=:moduleId LEFT JOIN tbl_tenant_modules tm ON tm.tenantId=t.id AND tm.moduleId=m.id WHERE t.id=:tenantId AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_users u WHERE u.id=:userId AND u.isActive=1 AND u.isPlatformAdmin=1) LIMIT 1
